name: 3 Extract Ligand from PDB
description: Extracts a specified ligand from a PDB file, preserving original coordinates, and saves it as an SDF file

pdb_id: The ID of the PDB file. The script expects a file named '{pdb_id}_A_NAD.pdb' to be present in the current working directory, which will be used as the input PDB file.
ligand_name: The three-letter residue name of the ligand to extract (e.g., '2TK'). The extracted ligand will be saved as '{ligand_name}.sdf'.
